query:
SELECT 
  po.id,
  po.docNumber,
  COUNT(poi.id) as total_itens
FROM purchaseOrders po
LEFT JOIN purchaseOrderItems poi ON po.id = poi.purchaseOrderId
WHERE po.docNumber = '71875'
GROUP BY po.id
